text:
Noor: quick idea: use observer leases to detect cross-region partitioning instead of electing primaries
Gabe: short answer: love it if it avoids full leader churn
Priya: main constraint: residency. we cannot accept writes from non-resident regions during failover
Liang: agreed. proxy must be authoritative for residency checks
Noor: proposal sketch: observers per region emit lease heartbeats (t=100ms). on quorum loss, mark region->DEGRADED and apply write-block policy
Gabe: how do we avoid false positives from brief packet loss?
Noor: add confirmation window: need N/2+1 observers and a confirm probe after 200-500ms jitter
Priya: operational knobs: observer_count, confirm_delay_ms, degraded_ttl_s, per-tenant auto_demote flag
Liang: and put residency metadata in JWT/tenant header so proxy can reject early: header X-Tenant-Residence: eu-west-1
Noor: rejection semantics: 409 + body {"error":"residency_violation","expected":"eu-west-1"} + header X-Residency-Hint: eu-west-1
Gabe: good to include hint header; SDKs can surface UI and retry guidance
Priya: caching note: proxies should cache tenant residency with small TTL (30s) and emit metric residency_cache_miss
Liang: cache entries should include stamp: residency=eu-west-1, stamp_ts=epoch, so caches can be invalidated on demote
Noor: runbook: (1) observer quorum lost -> emit alert + mark DEGRADED; (2) block cross-region writes; (3) create incident with candidate affected tenants; (4) auto rollback after rollback_window unless human confirmed
Gabe: add a test: partition eu-west for 45s in chaos grid and assert no write landed in non-resident region and that DEGRADED state cleared on heal
Priya: also need audit logs: observer_ids, timestamps, decision_reason, affected_tenants. tie to the rollout system per-tenant toggle
Liang: edge case: what if observers themselves are colocated with monitoring backend and get skewed? require at least one observer outside the subject region in quorum
Noor: and expose a metric observer_confirmation_latency_ms and observer_false_positive_rate (from canary runs)
infra-bot: deployed observer v1 canary to eu-west (0.1% traffic). No errors in last 2h
Gabe: next steps: Noor to write RFC with state machine ascii diagram + headers + sample HTTP payloads. Priya to propose proxy TTL defaults. Liang to spec cache stamps and invalidation. I'll own chaos tests
Noor: will ping when RFC draft ready. tagging @here for visibility :eyes:
